description: Our HD43 air game has been grounded. Just found out my aerial banner man died last month. Sad. Reached out to ask him to help provide air cover for Oktoberfest and our potential 10th combined arms campaign operation. Didn't answer so reached out by phone and spouse said he died. We did get to do the July 4th 250th USA Anniversary flight and the 150th Colorado on August 1. All the naysayers who kept saying it was a waste of money . . . it showed attitude with altitude. Will be missed.
